model:
rachana: 1
sutra: social-indicator
version: 1
description: 
match: { kind: social-indicator, priority: 10 }
title: { pill: "Politics and society · Social indicator", id: "$.INDICATOR_ID" }
strip:
  - { label: "Indicator", bind: "$.NAME", emphasis: true }
  - { label: "Latest", bind: "$.LATEST", fmt: "price2" }
  - { label: "Unit", bind: "$.UNIT" }
  - { label: "Year", bind: "$.LATEST_YEAR" }
  - { label: "Change (5y)", bind: "$.CHANGE_5Y", fmt: "signed2", tone: "sign" }
  - { label: "Source", bind: "$.SOURCE_NAME" }
panels:
  - id: series
    kind: line
    title: "Series"
    key: "F2"
    phone: { tier: "glance", from: "fragment" }
    rows: "$.SERIES"
    x: "YEAR"
    y: "VALUE"
    fmt: "price2"
  - id: byRegion
    kind: hbar
    title: "Region comparison (latest)"
    area: right
    phone: { tier: "glance", from: "fragment", rows: 5 }
    rows: "$.BY_REGION"
    label: "COUNTRY"
    value: "VALUE"
    fmt: "price2"
  - id: meaning
    kind: kv
    title: "What it measures"
    key: "F3"
    phone: { tier: "must", from: "fragment" }
    rows: "$.MEANING"
  - id: source
    kind: kv
    title: "Data source and licence"
    area: right
    phone: { tier: "must", from: "fragment" }
    rows: "$.PROVENANCE"
  - id: built
    kind: provenance
    title: "How this view was built"
    phone: { tier: "more", from: "fragment" }
  - id: refs
    kind: links
    title: "Linked entities"
    code: "REFS"
    area: right
    phone: { tier: "more", from: "fragment" }
keys: { F7: "link($.JURISDICTION, 'jurisdiction')", F8: "impact", F9: "raw" }
